description: The studio window listens for engine-line and login-step events; core:default is what grants the event API. Without this file Tauri v2 silently denies event.listen -- invokes work, every event is dropped, and the build screen freezes on stage one with an empty details log while the engine works perfectly underneath. start-dragging is granted explicitly: the title bar moves the window through Tauri's own drag API, because with titleBarStyle Overlay macOS keeps a transparent native title bar above the web content and the CSS -webkit-app-region never sees the press.
